title: That's Too Easy (LeBron)
blurb: No celebration, no gloating, just a flat observation about the size of the gap in ability. LeBron James dismissing something that other people find genuinely difficult is the purest form of the low-effort flex, and it has the added advantage of being demonstrably true when he says it. Play it after solving something trivially, or — far better — ironically, immediately after barely surviving something that was extremely hard and visibly cost you everything. The second usage is where most of the comedy lives.
origin: LeBron James's viral 'that's too easy' dismissal.
